title: 헬멧 안의 새벽
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad. A clean, arpeggiated electric guitar with a chorus effect plays a repetitive melodic pattern. A sub-bass synth provides sustained low-end notes on the downbeats. Soft, breathy female vocals are processed with high-frequency air and moderate hall reverb. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the guitar arpeggio and the vocal melody. Key of G Major. Tempo is 72 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean arpeggiated electric guitar with chorus effect]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals, sub-bass synth enters]
눈을 감으면 문이 보여
매일 밤 같은 문이야
손잡이를 돌리면 열려
그 안엔 네가 있었어
복도 끝 흐린 빛 아래서
네 목소리가 들려와
이름을 부르는 것 같아
